newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds up on talk of BZW positive view.
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds up on talk of BZW positive view.

text.p: Shares in Courtaulds rose over three percent in a weak market on Thursday amid talk that BZW had reiterated its positive view on the chemical and textiles group, market sources said.
Courtaulds shares rose as high as 454p before easing back to 447-1/2p by 1120 GMT, up 7-1/2p on the day. Over 530,000 shares had changed hands by that time.

"BZW reiterated its positive stance yesterday on Courtaulds but that came as the market was dropping after the rate rise so it had no impact. But with the market more stable today, the share is looking better," one marketmaker said.
Others, who had also heard of BZW's comments, said they were unaware of other factors which could have helped Courtaulds.
Marketmakers at BZW and Andrew Benson, the broker's chemical industry analyst, declined to comment.
